metadata.description: Decidio for Claude: the organisation's own decisions, approvals and policies, checked whenever they could change the answer (decidio), and a person's approval before Claude Code runs a destructive command (decidio-approvals, which brings decidio with it).

plugins.name: decidio
plugins.description: Claude checks your organisation's own decisions, approvals and policies in Decidio - who decided, what applies and whether it still holds - whenever they could change the answer, even when you don't name Decidio. The plugin brings the Decidio connector and the skill that tells Claude when to look.

plugins.name: decidio-approvals
plugins.description: A person approves Claude Code's destructive shell commands before they run - rm -rf, git push --force, DROP TABLE, terraform apply, kubectl delete, npm publish, curl | sh. Every session opens with one line saying it is on and who approves; everything else runs as before. Each approval is a sealed, verifiable Authority Receipt for that exact command. Installs the decidio plugin with it.
